grades.quote: For any trap (breakpoint, address misaligned, access fault, page fault, or guest-page fault) that writes a guest virtual address to `stval` , GVA is set to 1. For any other trap into HS-mode, GVA is set to 0.
grades.reason: Explains how GVA indicates a guest virtual address in stval, but not the general conditions for populating stval or omitting the address.
Describes generic page faults, not RISC-V stval contents.
Explains Sv57 address validity and page-fault generation, not whether stval records the faulting address.
Lists virtual-supervisor CSRs without explaining when stval contains a faulting virtual address.
